about:
New Berlin Plastics was founded in 1975 by William Aukofer and Robert Zeman in New Berlin, Wisconsin. After relocations in 1976 and 1982, the company moved into a 100,000-square-foot facility in 1998 that serves as its corporate headquarters and manufacturing site. In July 2001, Jeffery Held and Mark Siewert acquired the business and have since directed its growth.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, with a focus on scientific injection molding, medical device components, engineered plastic parts, and precision molded products for OEMs across Wisconsin and North America. Operations run from the 100,000-square-foot plant, supplemented by a recently acquired second building to meet rising demand. The firm emphasizes automation, mold flow analysis, and design-for-manufacturability support, and manages over 100 simultaneous customer projects through its proprietary LaunchLogic program.

New Berlin Plastics serves a diverse set of industries, including electrical utility, automotive and transportation, specialty hand and power tools, power sports, water treatment, building and construction, controls, healthcare and medical devices, lawn and garden, industrial, pet care, marine, and small engine. Customers are primarily OEMs that value high-quality engineered components and supply-chain reliability.

The company differentiates itself through tightly controlled scientific molding processes, a 99.8% customer acceptance rate, a 2.2% internal scrap rate, and a 98% on-time launch track record via LaunchLogic. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and has experience supporting UL-certified customer products. Automation integration and comprehensive value-added services — from resin selection to tool transfer — are cited as core strengths.
